resolved.title: SQL 运算符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]SQL Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Comparison Operators [/b]and [b]Logical Operators[/b] are used in the WHERE clause to filter the data to be selected.

The following comparison operators can be used in the WHERE clause: [img id="2805" width="100%"]
For example, we can display all customers names listed in our table, with the exception of the one with ID 5.[code format="sql" codeId="3041"]SELECT * FROM customers
[b]WHERE ID != 5;[/b][/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2806" width="100%"]
[note]As you can see, the record with ID=5 is excluded from the list.[/note]

content.text:
**比较运算符**和**逻辑运算符**在WHERE子句中用来过滤要选择的数据。

以下比较运算符可以在WHERE子句中使用。

|运算符|作用|
|-|-|
|`=`|等于|
|`!=`|不等于|
|`>`|大于|
|`>=`|大于等于|
|`<`|小于|
|`<=`|小于等于|
|`BETWEEN`|范围比较|

resolved.title: BETWEEN 运算符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The BETWEEN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The BETWEEN operator selects values within a range. The first value must be lower bound and the second value, the upper bound.

[s0l0!-header][b]The syntax for the BETWEEN clause is as follows:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="sql" ]SELECT column_name(s)
FROM table_name
WHERE column_name [b]BETWEEN [/b]value1 [b]AND [/b]value2;[/code]
The following SQL statement selects all records with IDs that fall between 3 and 7:[code format="sql" codeId="3042"]SELECT * FROM customers 
WHERE ID [b]BETWEEN [/b]3 [b]AND [/b]7;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result[/b]:[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2807" width="100%"]
[note]As you can see, the lower bound and upper bound are both included in the range.[/note]

resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设有个员工表**staff**，数据如下图：

![](/content/assets/280789dd0382390f960f.jpeg)

请写一个查询，输出工资`salary`在**1500**和**1900**之间的员工名字`firstname`。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The BETWEEN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following table named [b]staff[/b] : [img id="4470" width="100%"]
Write a query to output the [b]names[/b] of employees whose salaries are [b]between 1500 and 1900[/b].
[note]Combine the [b]WHERE[/b] statement with the [b]BETWEEN[/b] operator![/note]
resolved.hint_md: 将**WHERE**语句与**BETWEEN**操作符结合起来!

SELECT firstname
FROM staff
WHERE salary BETWEEN 1500 AND 1900

resolved.title: 文本值处理
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Text Values[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

When working with text columns, surround any text that appears in the statement with[b] single quotation marks (')[/b].

The following SQL statement selects all records in which the [i]City [/i]is equal to 'New York'.[code format="sql" codeId="3043"]SELECT ID, FirstName, LastName, City 
FROM customers
WHERE City = [b]'New York'[/b];[/code] 
[img id="2808" width="100%"]
[note]If your text contains an apostrophe (single quote), you should use two single quote characters to escape the apostrophe. For example: 'Can''t'.[/note]
